name: listicle
label: Listicle / Top 10 (any topic)
description: Ranked roundups and 'best of' videos on any topic: fast pacing, a title card per item.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).

llmGuidance: Ranked listicle on any topic (places, foods, inventions, animals...). Each item opens with its title card; then show the item itself first, B-roll of what the narration says about it second. Search with the item's name plus a visual word (e.g. 'Eiffel Tower aerial', 'sushi chef preparing').
